title: BUGFIX — P1 live orchestrator: write QC-passed videos to publish-ledger when PublishingAgent returns 0
rationale: scs001-live orchestrator produces captioned MP4 files but PublishingAgent returns 0 in live mode (posts via Telegram auto-deliver, not direct publish). Result: QC-passed videos never enter publish-ledger.jsonl, so posting-auto-deliver.ts never picks them up for Telegram delivery. Videos are stranded in workspace/scs001/run-<ts>/caption/ dirs. Fix: add Stage 9.5 ledger fallback — when live mode + published=0 + passedGates>0, write each QC-passed captioned video to publish-ledger.jsonl so auto-deliver can queue it.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts: add Stage 9.5 after PublishingAgent — in live mode with published=0 and passedGates>0, append each QC-passed captioned video to workspace/scs001/publish-ledger.jsonl for auto-deliver pickup.
